correctness.rationale: For every loopless arrow s→t, direct multiplication yields [x,y]_e=(alpha_s-alpha_t)v_e-(beta_s-beta_t)u_e. A bichromatic pair in k² gives q solutions to each prescribed arrow value; a monochromatic pair gives q² only at value zero. Independent variables across edges establish both fiber formulas. For r summands, concatenate r vertex color pairs: proper q^(2r)-coloring of the support is necessary and sufficient, proving the universal length and width formulas, including m=0 and characteristic two. Direct brute-force verification over q=2,3 and an explicit binary K5 decomposition replay successfully.

value.rationale: Natural universal invariant of all radical targets of loopless radical-square-zero quiver algebras; exact commutator length is a chromatic-number law and can exceed one even when the additive commutator span is the full arrow radical. Gives a sharp five-vertex binary obstruction with exactly one missing single-commutator target and an NP-completeness correspondence. Exact nonzero fiber counts refine a previously known zero-only Potts formula and are not a routine restatement or arbitrary finite census.
